reports.title: Germany's Merz vows to press on with reforms despite state election defeat
reports.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has said he plans to stay in office after his party suffered losses in two state elections on Sunday, vowing to push on with the government’s plans for potentially painful reforms.
